changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS shop_order_number_seq START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 1;

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE shop_product_categories ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, name varchar(160) NOT NULL, slug varchar(180) NOT NULL, description varchar(2000), active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, display_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_shop_category_slug UNIQUE (slug), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_category_display_order CHECK (display_order >= 0) );

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_shop_category_active_order ON shop_product_categories (active, display_order, name);

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE shop_products ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, name varchar(200) NOT NULL, slug varchar(220) NOT NULL, description varchar(5000), active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, display_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_shop_product_slug UNIQUE (slug), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_product_display_order CHECK (display_order >= 0) );

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_shop_product_active_order ON shop_products (active, display_order, name);

changeSet.author: adhesion
adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_shop_product_category_category ON shop_product_category_links (category_id, product_id);

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE shop_product_variants ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, product_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES shop_products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, sku varchar(100) NOT NULL, label varchar(160), active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, display_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, price_amount_cents bigint NOT NULL, price_currency char(3) NOT NULL, stock_tracked boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, stock_on_hand bigint, stock_reserved bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_shop_variant_sku UNIQUE (sku), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_variant_display_order CHECK (display_order >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_variant_price CHECK (price_amount_cents >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_variant_currency CHECK (char_length(price_currency) = 3), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_variant_stock CHECK ( (stock_tracked = false AND stock_on_hand IS NULL AND stock_reserved = 0) OR (stock_tracked = true AND stock_on_hand IS NOT NULL AND stock_on_hand >= 0 AND stock_reserved >= 0 AND stock_reserved <= stock_on_hand) ) );

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_shop_variant_product_active_order ON shop_product_variants (product_id, active, display_order);

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE shop_orders ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, order_number varchar(40) NOT NULL, customer_user_id bigint NOT NULL, status varchar(32) NOT NULL, total_amount_cents bigint NOT NULL, total_currency char(3) NOT NULL, version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_shop_order_number UNIQUE (order_number), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_order_total CHECK (total_amount_cents >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_order_currency CHECK (char_length(total_currency) = 3), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_order_status CHECK (status IN ( 'DRAFT', 'PENDING_PAYMENT', 'PAID', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED', 'REFUNDED' )) );

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_shop_order_customer_created ON shop_orders (customer_user_id, created_at);

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_shop_order_status_created ON shop_orders (status, created_at);

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE shop_order_items ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, order_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES shop_orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id bigint NOT NULL, product_name varchar(200) NOT NULL, product_variant_id bigint, variant_name varchar(160), sku varchar(100), unit_price_amount_cents bigint NOT NULL, unit_price_currency char(3) NOT NULL, quantity integer NOT NULL, stock_reserved boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, line_total_amount_cents bigint NOT NULL, line_total_currency char(3) NOT NULL, created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT ck_shop_order_item_quantity CHECK (quantity > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_order_item_unit_price CHECK (unit_price_amount_cents >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_order_item_line_total CHECK (line_total_amount_cents >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_order_item_currency CHECK ( unit_price_currency = line_total_currency AND char_length(unit_price_currency) = 3 ) );

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE shop_payments ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, order_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES shop_orders(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, status varchar(32) NOT NULL, expected_amount_cents bigint NOT NULL, expected_currency char(3) NOT NULL, version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_shop_payment_order UNIQUE (order_id), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_payment_amount CHECK (expected_amount_cents >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_payment_currency CHECK (char_length(expected_currency) = 3), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_payment_status CHECK (status IN ( 'CREATED', 'PENDING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED' )) );

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_shop_payment_status_updated ON shop_payments (status, updated_at);

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE shop_payment_attempts ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, payment_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES shop_payments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, provider_key varchar(80) NOT NULL, status varchar(32) NOT NULL, amount_cents bigint NOT NULL, currency char(3) NOT NULL, external_payment_id varchar(255), redirect_url varchar(2048), idempotency_key varchar(100) NOT NULL, failure_reason varchar(500), version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_shop_attempt_idempotency UNIQUE (payment_id, idempotency_key), CONSTRAINT uk_shop_attempt_provider_external UNIQUE (provider_key, external_payment_id), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_attempt_amount CHECK (amount_cents >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_attempt_currency CHECK (char_length(currency) = 3), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_attempt_status CHECK (status IN ( 'CREATED', 'PENDING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED' )) );

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_shop_attempt_payment_status ON shop_payment_attempts (payment_id, status);
